policy: Frozen before the implementation. Old B2 is main 11a9aa7; new B2 is this branch. Targets: the lengthening edits of the PR #104 survey whose chain was refused only because a following line is drawn in one text object with other text and whose growth has room once the elements move (geometry: fits). Places limited by capacity, protected content or the columns are counted apart and never reported as solved by separation. A following element moves only when its own candidate id is approved; acknowledge_inference or another approval never approves it; an approval is never carried from one step to another. A refusal ends its case and never counts as success; the first save and the edit back are counted apart; fixture successes are reported apart from real-PDF successes. Nothing is rasterised, painted over or reflowed; no other line moves.
procedure: propose; record the chain candidates (and what each separates)
save without approving them (a step needing one must be refused)
propose again approving exactly the listed candidates until no new one is listed (3 rounds at most); save approving them
reopen the saved PDF alone and edit back the same way
measures: saved or refused (reason); the chain evaluation's audits unchanged (safety and quality kept apart, structure, continued editing, moves, links, placement, raster); kept: glyphs, MuPDF and Poppler words (text, order, 0.01 pt), drawings and pixels (72, 150 dpi) outside the edited paragraph and the moved areas unchanged; the moved elements' words in the same order; the edit back against the source (glyph origins, line breaks, MuPDF and Poppler text, search, drawings, images, links, structure, pixels at 72 and 150 dpi)
target: at least one real lengthening edit newly saved by separating a following line, the other lines unchanged; else the reason per case
